north_star: 持续提升 RCL 作为可执行现实语义中间语言/现实事务演算的通用性、可表达性、可执行性、可验证性与现实鲁棒性；候选现实不得绕过证据、权限、版本、4R 与现实验证边界。

observations.signal: The new RCL-owned 4R commit gate structurally required causalParents/evidenceRequirements fields, but accepted empty causal ancestry and an empty evidence-requirement set; an accepted commit could therefore become detached from causal/evidence reality while still producing a deterministic commit root.
Declared Foundation-domain syntax remains outside the Native VM bytecode subset and is executed through provider bridges.
Whole-language native self-host closure remains bounded by Stage-0 host ownership.

ranked_candidates.problem: fail closed when commit-grade Foundation governance erases causal ancestry or all evidence requirements, while preserving RNCS-style causal-parent objects and binding accepted commit identity to the parent set
evidence: preserve existing RNCS beforeRoot parent shape

ranked_candidates.problem: lower declared Foundation-domain syntax directly into the native bytecode/runtime path
remove remaining Stage-0 host ownership from whole-language self-host closure

mode_reason: Three high-pressure domains remain coupled and the top candidate does not dominate by the DWAC 0.18 threshold; close the causal/evidence commit-integrity seam globally before entering the higher-risk native-lowering deep path.
behavioral_change: causalParents must be non-empty and every parent must carry a usable identity (string, root, beforeRoot, reference or id)
evidenceRequirements must be non-empty for commit-grade Foundation governance
RNCS-style causal parent objects with beforeRoot remain accepted
accepted decision receipts expose causal parent count
governanceRoot and commitRoot remain deterministically bound to the causal-parent set

targeted_local.materialization: exact candidate gate + exact candidate test file; Foundation contract import was materialized with the current canonical FOUNDATION_CONTRACT_VERSION=0.1.0 because this focused suite uses no other Foundation contract exports

ci_policy: Do not consume GitHub Actions for this autonomous cycle; focused validation was performed outside Actions.
truth_boundary: This cycle closes a commit-integrity bypass in the RCL-owned governance gate. It does not claim declared Foundation-domain syntax has become native VM syntax and does not claim repository-wide regression coverage.
